item.title: Round money only with round_money
item.content: Always round monetary Decimal results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

item.title: Money operations require idempotency_key
item.content: Every operation that moves money or changes a payment/credit must accept a keyword-only `idempotency_key`; check `ledgerly.audit.events()` for an existing entry with that key and return early without reapplying, and include `idempotency_key` in the audit entry you record.

review_comments: [team convention] Every operation that moves money or changes a payment/credit must accept a keyword-only `idempotency_key`. If an audit entry with the same key already exists (ledgerly.audit.events()), return without applying the operation again, and include `idempotency_key` in the audit entry you write. Introduced after the double-refund incident INC-204.
